subject: problem with lavaan and not with Mplus?

messages.author: 373e56ec89625c50
messages.subject: problem with lavaan and not with Mplus?
parts:
Sorry for being demanding with so many questions. My guess is that as soon as the semester begins more and more things need to get done.
 
I am having a little bit of an issue of fitting a pretty simple CFA model where lavaan gives me an error but Mplus estimates things without any problem. It's a one-factor model of binary (0/1) data. I thought I was doing the same thing in lavaan and Mplus but now I'm not sure whether this is true.
 
Here's my lavaan syntax:
 
mod1 <- 'F1 =~ NA*Item01+Item03+Item04+Item07+Item08+Item11+Item16+Item17+Item20+Item21+Item22+Item24+Item25+Item29+Item32 +Item33+Item35+Item39+Item41+Item42+Item44+Item52+Item58+Item63
         
         F1 ~~ 1*F1'

mod_run <- cfa(mod1, data=datum, ordered=c("Item01", "Item03", "Item04", "Item07", "Item08", "Item11", "Item16", "Item17", "Item20", "Item21", "Item22", "Item24", "Item25", "Item29", "Item32", "Item33", "Item35", "Item39", "Item41", "Item42", "Item44", "Item52", "Item58", "Item63"),estimator="WLSMV")

 

and this is the error it gives me:
 
Error in solve.default(B) :
  system is computationally singular: reciprocal condition number = 9.04545e-35

now, this is my Mplus syntax (here I recoded my variables by saying Item01=V1, Item03=V2, Item04=V3, Item07=V4....)
 
TITLE: Analysis
DATA: FILE IS DATA.dat;

VARIABLE: NAMES ARE V1-V24;
          CATEGORICAL ARE V1-V24;

ANALYSIS: ESTIMATOR=WLSMV;

MODEL:
         f1 BY V1-V24*;
         f1@1;

OUTPUT: SAMPSTAT;
        STANDARDIZED(STDYX);
        STANDARDIZED RESIDUAL;
        MODINDICES(ALL);

 
and for Mplus everything works perfectly. The lavaan and Mplus estimates are not even within the ballpark of each other and I do not get thresholds from lavaan (which is weird).
 
In all these months that I've been doing the lavaan/Mplus combo, I have never had a single dataset where Mplus could give me an answer and lavaan wouldn't... until today :-(

messages.author: 89c9fc822e34b78c
messages.subject: Re: problem with lavaan and not with Mplus?
parts:
On 01/09/2014 11:34 PM, oolve...@gmail.com wrote:
> Sorry for being demanding with so many questions.

> and this is the error it gives me:
> |
> Errorinsolve.default(B):
> system iscomputationally singular:reciprocal condition number
> =9.04545e-35

Ah. This turned out to be a (small but official) bug: lavaan computed
the wrong polychoric correlation for two variables if (and only if) they
are binary AND they happen to have exactly the same threshold (ie the
marginal distributions are identical). It turns out that your dataset
contains such a case:

> table(datum$Item04, datum$Item25)

0 1
0 6 18
1 18 154


lavaan 'detected' this case and tried to be clever but failed. This is
now fixed in the dev version of 0.5-16 (which again reproduces the Mplus
output).

Yves.
